text:
[Council File 26-1488]
Motion (Jurado - Padilla) relative to a Citywide notification and posting campaign to increase public awareness of the City's prohibition on buying, selling, or bartering live animals in public places.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Asks for a citywide notification and posting campaign to remind the public that buying, selling or bartering live animals in public places is prohibited.
